caption: This is a black-and-white technical drawing of a wooden side chair, labeled as "SIDE CHAIR MAHOGANY" designed and executed by Duncan Phyfe, with the company Ginsburg & Levy located at 815 Madison Ave, N.Y. City, and stock number 16735. The drawing features two views: a front view on the left and a side view on the right. In the front view, the chair’s backrest is shown with crossing diagonal and horizontal supports, including a small decorative panel in the upper right and detailed carving just below the seat, as well as small spherical or floral ornaments where the diagonal supports intersect. The seat has a rectangular shape with rounded edges and shows detailed trim along its front. The chair legs are depicted as slim and tapered, with fluted carvings down the center and small bun feet at the base. In the side view, the chair’s back leg is curved, attaching to the slightly reclined backrest, which also displays detailed carving at the upper portion. Dimensions are provided: the backrest height is 33 inches, the seat height is 18 3/4 inches, the seat width and depth are 15 inches each, and the thickness of the seat and trim is 2 1/4 inches. The drawing is executed on a light tan or off-white background with all annotations and outlines in dark ink, and contains the initials "J.F.R." at the bottom left.
title: Side Chair
